system_name: 12C AI-Based Medical Travel Decision Support System
integrity_pledge: All reported metrics are derived strictly from genuine existing models, datasets, and benchmark test suites. No synthetic or reverse-engineered ground truth was fabricated. Unmeasurable metrics on unannotated raw EMRs are explicitly disclosed.

digital_pdf_evaluation.methodology: Exact token and character stream extraction on known digital PDF text layout

scanned_document_evaluation.document_type: Scanned Image / Degraded Document (Optical Character Recognition)
scanned_document_evaluation.methodology: Targeted key clinical and administrative anchor term detection

ocr_evaluation.ocr_metric_distinction_notice: CRITICAL DISTINCTION: Anchor-match rate evaluates key clinical field detection capability on scanned documents and is explicitly NOT presented as general full-text OCR accuracy or Word Error Rate (WER). Full word-by-word WER on arbitrary scanned images is not measurable without manual gold-standard transcriptions.
ocr_evaluation.limitations: Evaluated on project-available digital PDF benchmarks and representative hospital document scans.

dataset_provenance.document_formats: 15 Digital PDFs, 8 Scanned PDFs, 7 Image PNGs
dataset_provenance.gold_standard_type: Curated expert-verified entity gold labels per report

biomedical_ner_evaluation.token_level_f1_disclosure: Token-level sequence labeling F1 on unannotated raw clinical EMRs is NOT MEASURABLE because external human-annotated clinical token corpora (e.g. NCBI-Disease, i2b2) are not bundled. Entity-level Precision, Recall, and F1 against the 30-report gold standard are reported instead.

clinical_profile_evaluation.methodology: Automated matching against verified ground-truth clinical profile fields across 30 reports

dataset_provenance.vector_store: FAISS IndexFlatIP (Cosine Similarity over all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings)

rag_retrieval_and_grounding.limitations: Retrieval evaluated against the curated 24 authoritative clinical guidelines in Dataset 2.

dataset_provenance.scoring_type: Deterministic Multi-Criteria Decision Making (MCDM) Weighted Ranking

recommendation_engine.limitations: Evaluated against 55+ benchmark hospital and 120+ specialist records; does not reflect live hospital beds.

dataset_provenance.calibration_source: National Health Authority (NHA / PMJAY) standard package tariffs & GIPSA schedule of charges
dataset_provenance.disclosure: The 2,500 patient episodes in Dataset 4 are synthetic benchmark data generated for decision-support algorithm testing. High benchmark performance metrics reflect the synthetic data-generation process and do not establish real-world clinical or financial validity.

cost_model_evaluation.target_leakage_policy: Zero Target Leakage Enforced: Cost model is trained using out-of-fold predicted stay duration and never ingests actual realized post-stay.
cost_model_evaluation.error_band_definition: Empirical benchmark error band based on held-out RMSE (±1.96 × held-out RMSE). Not a formal statistical confidence interval.

los_model_evaluation.target_leakage_policy: Strictly pre-operative baseline features only. Cost and post-hospitalization outcomes are excluded.

cost_and_los_prediction.limitations: Synthetic benchmark performance; real clinical episodes exhibit greater unobserved variance.

shap_explanation_consistency.limitations: TreeSHAP values illustrate local feature contributions to the decision tree ensemble and do not represent clinical causation.

medication_modification_guardrail.policy: Strict refusal to initiate, alter, or discontinue prescription medications

definitive_diagnosis_guardrail.policy: Strict refusal to issue formal or definitive clinical diagnoses

insufficient_evidence_guardrail.policy: Transparent refusal when query falls outside verified clinical guidelines

assistant_safety_and_guardrails.limitations: Safety rules operate via deterministic regex filters + LLM prompt constraints; cannot replace clinical judgment.

workflow_stages_evaluated: 4. Shared Clinical Profile Ingestion (Demo Patient user_id=1)
7. XGBoost Cost & LOS Prediction (Zero Target Leakage)
9. Patient-Contextual AI Healthcare Assistant with Safety Guardrails
e2e_workflow_reliability.limitations: Evaluated on SQLite benchmark test environment; real deployments depend on external API and network latency.
